card.name: Science and tech news headline verbs
card.fires_on: Reporting or result words in general science and technology news, such as says, observed, discovered, origin and process. It fires on the word that ends a headline or a clause about a finding.

modes.label: Reporting verbs
modes.description: Verbs like says, say, discovered or observed that announce a scientific finding.
modes.example: Mono lives up to its name as the "kissing disease," a new study<< says>>.

modes.label: Nouns about discoveries
modes.description: Nouns such as origin, process or record that name the subject of a science or tech story.

modes.description: Verbs about physical events or setup in science and engineering news.
modes.example: New 'water world' planet GJ1214b<< discovered>> that could support new life The new
